newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to resume trade in Banerj Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to resume trade in Banerj Tuesday.

text.p: Trade in Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj will resume Tuesday at 1430 local/1630 GMT, a spokesman for the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said.

Trade in the company's stock had been suspended since October 9 following a request by Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) for information on the rights of the bank's minority shareholders in light of its privatization.
Earlier today private bank Bozano, Simonsen, Banerj's administrator, said seven institutions prequalified to participate in the selloff of the bank later this year.
Bozano has been managing Banerj since early January to ready it for privatization.
